QuestInfo.name: Item Sent by Kyrin
QuestInfo.0: A message arrived from Nautilus, where the broken shuttle is being repaired.
QuestInfo.1: A message arrived from Nautilus, where the broken shuttle is being fixed, explaining that a fragment that doesn't match any of the shuttle's parts was found among the wreckage. It might be a fragment of the Core! However, the package from Kyrin was delivered in tatters, its contents nowhere to be found. Bart, who made the delivery, claims it's not his fault and that he only stopped in Perion on his way here to take care of a personal errand. Head to the mountains of Perion and see if you can retrace Bart's steps.
